TemplateDescription: Property valuation template for land properties

Elements.Label: Report Reference Number
Elements.HelpText: Unique reference number for this valuation report generated by the system. It will be incremented automatically for each new report.

Elements.Label: Valuation Date
Elements.HelpText: Date when the property valuation was conducted

Elements.Label: Inspection Date
Elements.HelpText: Date when the property was physically inspected

Elements.Label: Applicant Name
Elements.HelpText: Full name of the loan applicant/property owner

Elements.Label: Valuation Purpose
Elements.HelpText: Reason for conducting this property valuation

Elements.Label: Bank Branch
Elements.HelpText: Choose the specific bank branch for this application

Children.Label: Owner Details
Children.HelpText: Enter the full name, address and contact details of all property owners. For joint ownership, specify ownership share percentage for each owner.
Children.PlaceholderText: Name of the owner(s) and his/their address (es) with Phone no. (details of share of each owner in case of joint ownership)

Children.Label: Borrower/Client Name
Children.HelpText: Enter the full name of the borrower/client applying for the loan

Children.Label: Postal Address
Children.HelpText: Enter complete postal address including street name, landmark, city, state and PIN code

Children.Label: Property Description
Children.HelpText: Provide detailed description of the property including type, size, features and current condition

Children.Label: Plot No./Survey No.
Children.HelpText: Enter the official plot number or survey number as per property documents

Children.Label: Door No.
Children.HelpText: Enter the door number/house number assigned by local authorities

Children.Label: T.S. No./Village
Children.HelpText: Enter the Town Survey number and village name where property is located

Children.Label: Ward/Taluka/Tehsil
Children.HelpText: Enter the administrative division (ward/taluka/tehsil) where property is located

Children.Label: Mandal/District
Children.HelpText: Enter the mandal and district name where property is located

Children.Label: City/Town/Village
Children.HelpText: Select whether the property is located in a city, town or village

Children.Label: High/Middle/Poor
Children.HelpText: Select the socio-economic classification of the area where property is located

Children.Label: Urban/Semi Urban/Rural
Children.HelpText: Select whether the property is in an urban, semi-urban or rural area

Children.Label: Area Type
Children.HelpText: Select whether the area is primarily residential, commercial or industrial

Children.Label: Municipal Corporation
Children.HelpText: Select the municipal corporation under whose jurisdiction the property falls

Children.Label: State/Central Govt Enactments
Children.HelpText: Specify if property falls under any state or central government regulations/acts
Children.PlaceholderText: Whether covered under any State/ Central Govt. enactments...

Children.Label: Agricultural Conversion
Children.HelpText: For agricultural land, mention if conversion to residential/commercial plots is planned
Children.PlaceholderText: In case it is an agricultural land, any conversion to house site plots is contemplated

Children.Label: Latitude
Children.HelpText: Enter the latitude coordinates of the property location

Children.Label: Longitude
Children.HelpText: Enter the longitude coordinates of the property location

Children.Label: Site Area
Children.HelpText: Enter the total site area in specified units as per property documents

Children.Label: Valuation Area
Children.HelpText: Enter the area being considered for property valuation in specified units

Children.Label: Occupied By
Children.HelpText: Enter details of current occupants/tenants of the property

Children.Label: Access to Civic Amenities
Children.HelpText: Distance and accessibility to essential services and facilities
Children.PlaceholderText: Describe proximity and feasibility to schools, hospitals, bus stops, markets etc.

Children.Label: Flooding/Water Logging Risk
Children.HelpText: Possibility of frequent flooding or sub-merging

Children.Label: Permitted Usage Types
Children.HelpText: Type of use to which the land can be put

Children.Label: Usage Restrictions
Children.PlaceholderText: Describe any usage restrictions, zoning regulations, or building limitations...

Children.Label: Plot Location Type
Children.HelpText: Location of the plot in the layout

Children.Label: Land-locked Property
Children.HelpText: Whether the property has free access or is land-locked

Children.Label: Site Advantages & Features
Children.HelpText: Positive aspects that enhance the property value
Children.PlaceholderText: Describe unique advantages, features, or selling points of the site...

Children.Label: Special Remarks & Notifications
Children.HelpText: Include any threat of acquisition, road widening, CRZ provisions, etc.
Children.PlaceholderText: Any special remarks, notifications, or additional information...

Children.Label: Min Rate (Rs)
Children.PlaceholderText: Enter minimum market rate in Rs

Children.Label: Max Rate (Rs)
Children.PlaceholderText: Enter maximum market rate in Rs

Children.Label: Estimated Value of Land
Children.PlaceholderText: Total Extent of the Plot × Valuation Rate

Children.Label: Is Building Constructed?
Children.HelpText: Select whether a building exists on the property

Children.Label: Average Floor Height (ft)
Children.HelpText: Typical floor height in feet

Children.Label: Total Plinth Area Floor-wise
Children.HelpText: Total built-up area across all floors

Children.Label: Age & Maintenance Remarks
Children.PlaceholderText: Additional remarks about building age, maintenance history, or special conditions...

Children.Label: Valuer Comments on Plan & Construction
Children.PlaceholderText: Any observations, discrepancies, or additional comments regarding building plans and construction...

Children.Label: Land Valuation Basis
Children.DefaultValue: Valuation restricted to land only as no building exists on the property.
Children.PlaceholderText: Remarks on land valuation considering no building exists...
